headline: Mild and mostly dry now; wet, windy weather returns Friday into next week.
summary: A warm front brought unusually mild air today, with temperatures near daily records and mostly dry weather inland. A cold front will stall offshore through Thursday. The bigger story is a deep dip in the jet stream, the fast band of winds high in the atmosphere, over the Gulf of Alaska. It will send a weakened occluded front, where cold and warm air have merged, onshore on Friday. A string of additional systems follows, so the weekend looks soggy, with a brief break Monday before a wetter, possibly windy front Tuesday. Friday brings breezy to locally windy conditions and large surf along the coast. Exact wind tracks remain uncertain. The Skokomish River, at moderate flood stage, may rise again with weekend rain.
